name: Prelude FLNG, Browse Basin
description: Turret-moored to 16 seabed driven piles; designed for Category 5 cyclones; 200 km off Western Australia

milestones.event: Shell approved funding for Prelude FLNG
Hull launched/floated out at Geoje, South Korea
Prelude arrived on station off Western Australia after 5,800 km maiden voyage
Shutdown after electrical problem and two unintended gas releases NOPSEMA called dangerous
UPS room fire, ESD1/ESD0 and total loss of power; extended unstable power period
